Without consent, a transfer is possible only in the 40-21 day window before expiry (pre-approval from MOM). The construction page has the same rule.

Official guidance supports 1: An employer can apply to move a Work Permit holder to an S Pass if the worker meets S Pass criteria and quota allows. S Pass holders may then apply for PR (ICA).
